en: Riding Alone for a Thousand Li

name.en: Riding Alone for a Thousand Li

desc.zh: 关羽得到了刘备的消息，准备动身启程。
desc.en: Guan Yu has received word from Liu Bei and is preparing to set out.

if.zh: 玩家势力 != 曹操 或 关羽是玩家本人 或 曹操是玩家本人

desc.zh: 和关羽一同前往许昌，与曹操告别。
desc.en: Head to Xuchang with Guan Yu to bid farewell to Cao Cao.

desc.zh: 和关羽出发，前往第一个关口东岭关。
desc.en: Set out with Guan Yu for Dongling Pass, the first pass.

desc.zh: 继续前进，下一关为洛阳关。
desc.en: Continue forward. The next pass is Luoyang Pass.

if.zh: [个人战][舌战][论战]结果 = 胜利
[个人战][舌战][论战]结果 != 胜利

desc.zh: 前方有探子来报，称下一关关主在路途当中等待车队，继续向前行进。
desc.en: Scouts ahead report that the defender of the next pass awaits the wagon train along the way. Continue advancing.

if.zh: [个人战][舌战][论战]结果 = 胜利

desc.zh: 继续向荥阳关方向前进。

if.zh: [个人战][舌战][论战]结果 = 胜利

desc.zh: 刘备已经前往汝南，改向汝南前进，先前往附近的农家休息。
desc.en: Liu Bei has set out for Runan. Change course toward Runan and rest at a nearby farmstead first.

if.zh: [个人战][舌战][论战]结果 = 胜利
[个人战][舌战][论战]结果 != 胜利

desc.zh: 继续前进，前往汝南和刘备会合。
desc.en: Continue forward to Runan and rendezvous with Liu Bei.

desc.zh: 与一行人向新野出发，投靠刘表。
desc.en: Set out with the group toward Xinye to seek refuge with Liu Biao.

if.zh: [个人战][舌战][论战]结果 = 胜利

story.zh: 报答了曹操恩情的关羽，在得知兄长去处后，决定即刻护送二位嫂嫂出发。
story.en: Having repaid Cao Cao's kindness, Guan Yu learns of his elder brother's whereabouts and resolves to escort his two sisters-in-law on their journey at once.

trigger.zh: 曹操、刘关张、甘梅、糜贞存活。许昌属曹操。
trigger.en: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Gan Mei, and Mi Zhen are alive. Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao.

forbidden.zh: 主角是甘梅、糜贞、周仓时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Gan Mei, Mi Zhen, or Zhou Cang.

participate.zh: 【与关羽的关系等级至少为2级】，【不在曹操势力】或【主角为关羽】
